concepts.def: Vibrations perpendicular (light) or parallel (sound) to travel.

v = f × λ, the speed a wave travels.
Maximum displacement from the rest position; relates to energy.
Radio to gamma; all travel at the speed of light in a vacuum.
Waves bounce off surfaces or change direction when changing medium.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Waves — a core area of A-Level Physics.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Waves brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Waves.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
